changes.summary: Patch request: after the sentence on the word normal in def:p15-nda-law-and-moments, link the GK general attraction/domain/type definitions (def:p15-w02c-p15-016-attraction, thm:p15-w02c-p15-016-types).

Durrett p. 152: Theorem 3.4.14 attributed to Levy; framed as the last word on normal convergence; GK described as containing the last word on many results on sums of independent variables (marked quotation); link to thm:p15-nda-characterization; the p. 152 Remark and its Section 3.6/3.8 pointer.

thm:p15-w02c-p15-016-stable (S_n/n^{1/alpha} => Y, E e^{itY}=exp(-C|t|^alpha), Y nondegenerate, not chi, not normal), worked case thm:p15-w02c-p15-016-cauchy-case (alpha=1, C=pi/2, scaled Cauchy limit), warning on hypotheses and the alpha=2 boundary.

Full proofs: law of X from (3.8.1) and its equivalence with the symmetric form; real transform; 0<C<infinity; scaling limit by monotone convergence; product and (1+c_n/n)^n; continuity theorem; modulus comparison excluding all normal laws; alpha=1 constant via Polya density; infinite mean; no constant limit in probability.

GK definitions of attraction for laws (Section 35, pp. 171-172) and of types (p. 40); lemma thm:p15-w02c-p15-016-types; p. 172 framing claims (stable-only nonempty domains via §33, complete solution in §35, normal domain very wide versus other stable domains of similar character); Theorem 1 display; footnote attribution to Khintchine [52], Feller [27], Levy [75] with bibliography data (pp. 258-260); proof boundary separating proved and reported claims.
Proof that domains of attraction are invariant under the type relation.

annex:p15.nda-examples: part 1 names the centering n mu and verifies the hypotheses of the construction and sufficiency theorems; part 3 proves that the tail hypothesis fixes the law of |X| (P(|X|<=1)=0) and of X, derives H_X, q_X and the limit (2-alpha)/alpha, checks nondegeneracy, and reduces any nondegenerate normal target to chi before applying thm:p15-nda-characterization.
Patch requests: body part-1 statement of thm:p15-nda-examples names the centering S_n - n mu; driver insertions of the owned body and annex files per the insertion proposal.

proposed_decisions: Symbol overlap: C is Durrett's constant in thm:p15-w02c-p15-016-stable and a truncation level in thm:p15-nda-gk-truncated-mean; each is locally declared.

Symbol overlap: B_n is the GK scaling constant in def:p15-w02c-p15-016-attraction and a cutoff variance in thm:p15-nda-gk-cutoff-interface; V is GK's attracting law here and a truncated variance in thm:p15-nda-moments-and-shifts; W is a distribution function here and appears only subscripted (W_Z) in the NDA chapter.
Durrett's display at body line 40 uses his plain P and E, as printed on p. 152.
